summary: Multidisciplinary engineer with hands-on experience designing, building and testing complex industrial and experimental equipment across mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and control systems.

bullet_points.text: Designed, manufactured, assembled and tested custom industrial equipment, working across mechanical, electrical and control systems, from concept through prototype validation, including an IP69K-rated dynamic checkweigher.
Performed troubleshooting and technical improvements on existing industrial production lines, including filling and capping equipment, through multiple interventions at a customer site.
Developed and integrated electrical and control systems for industrial equipment, including PLC-based control, I/O, industrial communications, sensors, actuators and motion systems.
Manufactured precision mechanical components, including a custom rocket motor.

link.display: SolarShape: Solar Concentrator for Industrial Processing (PRR-funded project)

children.text: Led the development and integration of a solar concentration system for direct industrial heat production, coordinating mechanical, optical, electrical, and control subsystems up to prototype validation.
Independently designed the electrical layout and produced schematics using SkyCAD; performed wiring, component mounting, signal verification and troubleshooting.

Engineered machine control logic in CODESYS using IEC 61131-3 Structured Text, with EtherCAT for real-time motion control; developed a Go-based vision processing service and web interface integrated via OPC UA.
Developed and validated a solar-powered 3D printer proof of concept, coupling concentrated solar energy to the printhead through an optical fiber.

bullet_points.text: Conducted mechanical testing under high strain-rate loading using a Split-Hopkinson pressure bar system, diagnosing experimental setups and analyzing material response.
Developed and operated high-speed data acquisition systems using NI-DAQ and LabVIEW, acquiring signals from strain gauges and custom-developed capacitive displacement sensors.
Installed, configured, and troubleshot instrumentation, sensors, and experimental equipment for testing under cryogenic and high-temperature conditions.
Supervised students during experimental procedures and Master's thesis development.

education.institution: Instituto Superior Técnico — University of Lisbon
education.dissertation_title: Development of an advanced concentrated solar collector for direct use of solar energy in industrial processes.

bullet_points.text: Designed, built and experimentally validated a two-axis solar tracking and real-time motion control system, integrating predictive algorithms with computer-vision feedback (OpenCV).
Developed and tested mechanical, optical, electrical and motion-control components for a solar concentrator prototype.
Designed and manufactured mechanical components, including precision-machined paraboloid mirrors, and evaluated different configurations experimentally.
Built and experimentally validated a 200 W solar-thermal demonstration prototype.
